item.title: The Dishtectives is Like a Book Club But for Food Lovers
item.description: The Dishtectives at Persimmon. The Dishtectives is like a book club, except the focus is food. Every Wednesday, a group of ten to fourteen people book a reservation for a different restaurant in Providence. They bring their “Dishcovery”-branded, black notebooks and pens, and take over a large table to socialize, share dishes and discuss the food. The group of friends...
